status: Conditional reach target for one integrated apparatus trial; not manufacturer reach, complete supported lift or operating pass
limitations: Swing arm 4416.015 and holder 4416.003 are manufacturer-listed with a 150 kg permissible hoist-arm load, but the published catalogue gives no arm radius or confirmed attachment to these specific standards. The 1015.995 target is not an actual reach or rated capacity.

The central added standard and its 150 foot are an authored proposal, not a manufacturer-complete four-standard tower. Its couplings, load path, ties, soleboard, guard gate and use with this winch require a qualified design.
The 751-wide routes are plan strips between open door-leaf and centre-foot reservations, not tested routes around actual stairs, plates, tools, workers, shutter, braces or loaded movements.

Receiver mass, slings, hook/arm height, roof/corner and existing weather-layer clearance, supported lowering, travel and release are not established. The actual hoist may not lift the receiver assembly.

A fixed-radius arm directly above the centre module requires 900 at installed y4525 and 500 after 400 outward at y4925; one fixed radius cannot occupy both. The module must be positively supported for a qualified release/reposition/re-engagement, or an actually permitted variable reach/load path must be supplied.
The arc is a point-centre stress, not a complete carrier, rope, module, personnel or dropped-load sweep. Workers must be outside the suspended-load exclusion zone; no rescue is inferred.
